title: feat(studio): Save and Cancel in the item header, the AI assistant at the end of every title row
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgTC1DCWJ4MisoLdbUU1V1sb)_

Fixes #37455

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在 Studio 里改对象、流程、权限集等时，「取消 / 保存」出现在详情页头的右侧；AI 助手按钮（没有 AI 时是右侧栏开关）出现在每个页面标题行的最右边，和前端应用的页头一样；顶栏不再有这几个按钮。
- 为什么做：App Studio 改版要去掉顶栏，这几个按钮先搬到新家（父卡里你选的「按推荐启动」）。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某个页面找不到保存或 AI 按钮（快捷键仍可开关右侧栏），不丢数据，撤回这个改动即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。整个 Studio（含弹窗、菜单、命令面板）已改用 Studio 自己的石墨色，不再跟随应用主题色，离开 Studio 后应用恢复自己的颜色。

## What changes

The Studio top bar's page controls move to the open page's own title row. The surface still owns and builds them (save coordinator, right slot, robot control); only their place changes, so their logic is untouched and the two cards that change the save controls next (#37440, #36660) rebase onto `studioSaveBar.tsx` unchanged.

- **New `studioTitleRow.tsx`.** `StudioTitleRowProvider` (mounted by `StudioDesignSurface`) hands the rendered controls to the page's title rows. Every title row registers its row element, and only the first in document order draws the controls, so a page never draws two Saves (a header nested in the page's own, or an embedded compact row, draws nothing). Outside the surface nothing is drawn, so Setup's metadata pages are unchanged.
- **Cancel and Save** end `StudioItemHeader`'s right-aligned action slot, after the pillar's actions (the detail header's ‹ ›, primary button and ⋯). Per the area PM's increment (ADR-0084 amendment draft, PR #37470), a page that saves with no item header ends its own title row with them (`StudioTitleRowEnd`).
- **The AI assistant** (or, with no copilot served, the right slot's show / hide icon) ends every title row behind a hairline, as `PageHeader` ends with the shell's button group (#36111): the item header, the list page's title row (`PageShell`, list and compact rows, not when embedded), the directory and diagnostics headers.
- **The top bar** loses only those controls. Its other tenants, including "create app" / "app waits for publish", Changes and Publish, are untouched (#37456 removes the bar; #37454 moves Publish).
- **Studio draws graphite everywhere.** `main` (with #37452's `STUDIO_ACCENT`) is merged once (99c3443c). The accent is mounted on the Studio root (the `StudioMenuProvider` frame in `StudioDesignSurface`), so every button, link, hover and focus ring inside Studio reads graphite under any app theme.
- **Portalled surfaces too.** Dialogs, popovers, dropdowns, sheets, tooltips, toasts and the command palette render in a portal on `body`, outside the root, and the `@object-ui/components` primitives take no portal container (giving them one is outside this card's surface). So the new `studioAccent.ts` puts the same classes (and a `data-studio-accent` marker) on `body` while a Studio surface is mounted, counted per surface, and takes them off with the last unmount. The app's inline branding on the page root is never touched, so nothing needs repair when Studio leaves.

## Tests

- `StudioDesignSurface.saveBar-36511`: re-pointed, not weakened. Cancel and Save are asserted inside the object page's item header (`data-object-header`), absent from the top bar, drawn exactly once, and Save is still the last action (only the assistant follows). The draft case still asserts Changes and Publish in the top bar and that Publish waits for Save.
- `StudioDesignSurface.rightSlot-12725`: a new top-level describe. On the sharing overview the AI assistant ends the item header behind the hairline, is absent from the top bar, and still hides and shows the slot. On a list page it ends the list's title row, inside the page.
- `studioTitleRow.test.tsx` (new): the order in an item header (pillar actions, Save, hairline, assistant); no hairline with nothing before it; nested and later rows draw nothing (one Save, one assistant); the outer header of a nested pair wins; the next row takes over when the first goes; a page with no item header ends its own row with Save; and the control: outside the surface nothing is drawn.
- `StudioDesignSurface.graphite-37455` (new): the app's theme is written by the app shell's own `useAppShellBranding` (rose primary, amber accent), not by hand. CONTROL: that theme is on the page root and is not graphite. The Studio root carries every accent class and contains the header, the page and the AI button. The command palette (portalled) is outside the root and sits under the accent on `body`. Studio unmounted: every accent class and the marker leave `body`, and the page root's `--primary` is as the app wrote it.
- Ablations of the graphite pins (each restored, `git diff HEAD` empty): root class removed, 2 red (root, portal); body hook removed, 2 red (portal, unmount); the cleanup's remove line deleted, 1 red (unmount).
- Reverse verification: with `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `StudioItemHeader.tsx` and `PageShell.tsx` restored to the base commit, 9 of the 13 new or re-pointed cases go red (the 4 that stay green are the outside-the-surface control and the unchanged slot cases); restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Pages with no title row in a package scope (the loading state, a not-found page) draw no assistant; `⌘.` still opens and switches the slot there.
- Portalled surfaces get graphite through the `body` class, not a portal container: the primitives take none, and adding one is outside this card's surface. A portal container inside the Studio root would make the `body` class unnecessary.
- In the real console the app's branding does not reach Studio at all today: the app shell's branding hook clears its inline tokens when the app unmounts, so `html` falls back to the default blue on entering Studio. Studio still draws graphite over that default, as the readings below show; the jsdom pin covers the case where the app's branding stays on the page root.
- The directory and diagnostics headers are outside `studio-design/`; they are the "list title row" of their pages and get one line each.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `studioAccent.ts`: the `body` class while Studio is mounted, and its counted cleanup (a leak would tint the app's own pages graphite).
2. The `StudioDesignSurface` hunk that mounts `STUDIO_ACCENT` on the root and builds `titleRowSave` / `titleRowAssistant`.
3. `studioTitleRow.tsx` (the one-owner registry) and the `StudioItemHeader` action-slot hunk.

<details><summary>Real-browser readings (Chromium, deviceScaleFactor 2, light and dark)</summary>

Backend: `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev`), console from this branch. The showcase app is the branded app used (its branding is violet `#7C3AED`); no example app writes its theme any other way. A writable package `com.acme.studio-demo` with one object `sdemo_task` was created through the API to show Save and Cancel. Shots: `shots-37474/` on the project's card folder.

| Shot | `html --primary` | `body --primary` | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 app page, branded | light `262 83% 58%`, dark `262 73% 65%` (inline) | same | violet menu highlight and links; `body` carries no accent |
| 2 Studio, entered client-side from the app | light `211 100% 50%`, dark `211 100% 60%` | light `220 9% 23%`, dark `220 9% 83%` | active menu item graphite |
| 3 object page after an edit | as 2 | as 2 | Cancel and Save at the right of the object's header, none in the top bar; Save background light `rgb(53, 57, 64)`, dark `rgb(208, 210, 216)` |
| 4 command palette (portal) | as 2 | as 2 | dialog under the `body` accent, its `--primary` light `220 9% 23%`, dark `220 9% 83%` |
| 5 menu and list page | as 2 | as 2 | the list's title row has its end slot (`studio-title-row-end`) |

NOT MEASURED in the browser: the AI assistant button and the right-slot toggle. The showcase backend serves no copilot, and none of the opened pages claims the right slot, so neither control is drawn there; their place is pinned by `rightSlot-12725` and `studioTitleRow`.

</details>

Two-minute check: from a branded app, open an object in Studio (`/studio/PACKAGE/metadata/object/NAME`) and change its label on Settings: Cancel and Save appear at the right of the object's header, the top bar shows neither, and Save, the active menu item and the ⌘K palette are graphite, not the app's colour; with a copilot served, the robot sits at the far right after a hairline.
